## [0.40.0](https://github.com/cellajs/cella/compare/0.39.0...0.40.0) (2026-11-07)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* the protocol routes follow their standards: a step-up cookie, held mail links, a bearer challenge on every machine 401, MCP version negotiation, push topics and one-click unsubscribe ([#1742](https://github.com/cellajs/cella/issues/1742))
* users and organizations name their fields as AEP does: givenName, familyName, languageCode, regionCode and timeZone ([#1741](https://github.com/cellajs/cella/

**Flow runs write an event log with lineage and gate approval records. New CLI
actions read the log, check it against a published schema, and compare runs.**
No worker, judge or pilot prompt changes.

- Flow event log. Each run writes `events.jsonl` next to `run.json`: `run.started`, one `step` for each node visit, `gate.waiting` and `run.finished`. Each event names its parent event. A step records the edge that led to it (`via`: from node, `when`, edge index), so a repair step points back at the failed che

The lean Codex home reads `config.toml` as TOML statements, and four smaller fixes: the model reader, a file with a byte order mark (Codex config and Claude Code settings), `models sync --apply` in a folder that is not writable, and the CodeGraph command after an interrupt. See docs/CHANGELOG.md.

Claude Code workers start with a lean profile: the project, not the person. A worker start went from 108,700 to 33,500 context tokens on the measured machine. `PUPPETMASTER_CLAUDE_LEAN=0` turns it off. See docs/CHANGELOG.md.
`models sync --apply` no longer changes auto-routing, and seven smaller fixes. See docs/CHANGELOG.md.
Usage counts and the Codex session lookup accept bad stored values. See docs/CHANGELOG.md.
28 bug fixes from an audit of small functions. Each bug has a regression test. See docs/CHANGELOG.md.
A CodeGraph command that times out no longer leaves a process alive. See docs/CHANGELOG.md.

`puppetmaster models sync` adds new starter models to an old registry. New entries are written with `enabled: false`, so auto-routing does not change. `doctor` has the check `registry-starter-sync`. See docs/CHANGELOG.md.
Hermes: puppetmaster-learn is a catalog plugin that fires on session end (NousResearch/hermes-agent#153891). See docs/CHANGELOG.md.
Agentic: Chat Completions tool calls send vendor fields back (Gemini 3 thought signatures, #296). Flow: escalate_model runs code repairs on a stronger model. See docs/CHANGELOG.md.

Updates now keep Tidesight's code private.

- **The update keeps the permissions of the code it replaces.** If `app/` is closed to other accounts (the deployment guide's `chmod 700 app`), every folder and file of the new code is too, and so is the download while it is checked. The copies refreshed in the website's folder get the modes the web server needs (`tidesight.fcgi` 755, `.htaccess` 644).
